observations.title: Control mob spawning through rules
observations.player_action: An administrator edits spawn.json and, where supported, spawner.json under config/incontrol.
observations.outcome: Conditional rules can reject spawns or change permitted mobs' properties; added spawning and filtering are separate rule stages.
conditions: potentialspawn.json is explicitly a 1.12 mechanism; do not apply it to 1.20.1 from an old guide.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: This is administrator rule machinery. Its actual spawn/death/loot owner events and effective config are the evidence; no player inventory signal represents rule evaluation.

conditions: Rule order, accepted fields and reload behavior must match installed In Control documentation/source.
